_START_HERE: EASIEST WAY TO EDIT: run start-editor (see README.txt). It opens your website with an edit toolbar - click any text to type, click any image to replace it, and press Save.
EDITING THIS FILE BY HAND also works. Page sections are listed in 'sections' in the SAME ORDER they appear on the page. Move a block up or down to move the section.
Every section has  "enabled": true/false  (false hides it) and a 'name' (only a label for you).
Lists (items, services, ...) are made of { } blocks. Copy a block to add one, delete a block to remove one, or add  "hidden": true  to switch one off.
Anything starting with an underscore (like this note) is a comment and is ignored.

_servicesHelp: One { } block = one service customers can add.
price: price of ONE unit, as a plain number (8 or 8.50).
extraDiscount: how many % this service takes off the WHOLE order each time a customer adds one more. Harder service = bigger number.
max: most units a customer can order. startQty: how many are pre-selected when the page opens.
id: any short unique word with no spaces.

services.name: Ad images
services.description: Ad Image / Website Hero / Product Listing

services.name: Ad copy
services.description: Persuasive captions for your ad campaigns

_discountHelp: HOW THE DISCOUNT WORKS: the most expensive unit in the order is the 'starter' and adds no discount. Every other unit adds its service's extraDiscount % to ONE order-wide discount, which is applied to every item.
momentum: makes each additional unit worth a little more than the one before (0.05 = each next unit counts 5% more). Set 0 for a flat rate.
discountCap: the biggest total discount, in %. 50 = never more than half off.
discountStartsAfterFirstItem: true = the first unit adds nothing. false = every unit adds.

_help: FLASH DEAL: an extra % off the WHOLE total, applied AFTER the normal discount (not limited by the max discount).
type: time (ends at endsAt) | slots (ends when slotsLeft reaches 0) | both (whichever comes first) | always (no end, just a label).
endsAt: end date/time, e.g. 2026-12-01T23:59:00-05:00 (the -05:00 is your time zone). Easier: Settings > Flash deal in the editor.
slotsLeft: YOU lower this number when you sell a spot (the site cannot count sales). Keep it true.
showSeconds: false = the clock shows days/hours/minutes only (updates every 20 s).
